answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions a set of identity slots, so bulk fakes must outbid real agents. Only 100 slots ripen per epoch, a walnut harvest with set yield; open bids decide the winners, each a signal of value. Winners lock bids for 20 epochs; a cheating slot is revoked and its bid burned. An attacker wanting 200 fake identities must buy 200 slots at 50 copper each: 10,000 copper in total, while an honest agent pays once for one slot.
